scripture.verse: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
For who maketh thee to differ from another?

sermons.title: Sermon 263 | The Story of God's Mighty Acts

scripture.verse: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

sermons.title: Sermon 264 | How Saints May Help the Devil

scripture.verse: That thou mayest bear thing own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.

sermons.title: Sermon 265 | The Meek and Lowly One

scripture.verse: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart; and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging. And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me. And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou son of David, have mercy on me. And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee. And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus. And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight. And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.

sermons.title: Sermon 267 | The Tabernacle of the Most High

scripture.verse: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.

sermons.title: Sermon 268-270 | The Ceremony of Laying the First Stone of the New Tabernacle

scripture.verse: Before Jehovah's awful throne Ye nations bow with sacred joy; Know that the Lord is God alone; He can create, and he destroy. We are his people, we his care,
scripture.reference: Our souls and all our mortal frame;

scripture.verse: Por lo cual también yo padezco estas cosas; sin embargo, no me avergüenzo, porque sé a quién he creído, y estoy seguro de que es poderoso para guardar lo que le he encomendado para aquel día.
